scope: Read-only review of stashes and untracked Apple Silicon experiments; original files and stashes preserved.

stashes.contents: ARM fallback GCD/UV streaming, optional fixed-limb ARM helpers, instrumentation and benchmark flags. No NUCOMP, mpz_xgcd_partial or proof-construction changes.
Disable expensive GMP self-checks in CPU fixed_integer helpers; build cleanup. gpu_integer names do not provide a Metal/ANE backend.

untracked.arm_test_repo: Base commit 9a5dc61; nested experiments include specialized 8/12/16/20-limb multiply-subtract assembly.
untracked.test_repo: Base commit 9a5dc61; uncommitted ARM schoolbook multiplication with stack buffers in avx512_integer.h.
untracked.src/arm_gcd_test.cpp: Reference-versus-assembly arithmetic equivalence cases; useful test material if porting fixed-limb kernels.
untracked.tools/arm64_gcd_tuning.md: M4 Max old software pipeline, about90KIPS; not comparable to current hardware proof path.

relevance: Current hardware proof construction calls nucomp_form/nudupl_form, qfb_nucomp/qfb_nudupl, mpz_xgcd_partial and GMP. Old fixed-integer software GCD pipeline is not linked into this ARM hardware client. No direct stash restore selected.
correctness_finding: stash@{0}:src/gcd_unsigned.h mul_sub_u64 computes subtrahend=ly+borrow then borrow=(lx<subtrahend), losing carry from ly+borrow if ly=UINT64_MAX and borrow=1. Needs correction and targeted tests before reuse.
decision: Preserve tests and prototypes as reference. Do not adopt old software-path flags/kernels as a proof optimization without an adapter, equivalence tests and actual proof-delivery A/B.
